content.text: T050: the Stop hook re-ingests the whole transcript every time. Give each transcript a checkpoint so only the new records are ingested.
The hook verbs already open the transcript in graphknows/integrations/claude_code/hooks.py, so the checkpoint belongs beside them rather than in a new module.
Settled: the Checkpoints class lives in graphknows/integrations/claude_code/hooks.py, keyed by transcript path and storing the uuid of the last record read.
What about the line the harness is halfway through writing?

_whole_records stops at the first line that will not parse. A transcript is append-only, so the first unparseable line is the line being written: stopping there costs one event's delay, never a lost record.
